name: enrich-insights
summary: Derive structured Fact lines from normalized source fragments, echoing source_fragments for linear chain composition.
description: Second node of the report.* chain. For each non-empty source fragment, classifies a signal keyword (browser/edge/cloud/general), tidies whitespace, extracts the first $-prefixed or bare number token if present, emits a Fact line, then stable-sorts by (signal rank, first-seen index). 1.1.0 additionally echoes source_fragments verbatim so the downstream report.summarize node can draw both its inputs from this single predecessor under browserLocalPlan's linear chain search (registry#441). Pure, deterministic, memory-only; enrichment logic unchanged from 1.0.0.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want browser, edge, and cloud fragments classified into ordered Fact lines while the original source_fragments are passed straight through, so that the summarize step receives both the raw fragments and the structured evidence from one upstream node.

structured_facts: Fact: browser — Browser session count rose
Fact: edge — Edge cache hit ratio climbed
Fact: cloud — Cloud region latency improved

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want a dollar amount captured on the Fact line when a fragment mentions spend, so that numeric signals survive into the formatted report.

structured_facts: Fact: browser — Browser spend hit $12.50 yesterday ($12.50)

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want an empty fragment list to produce an empty structured_facts array, so that later nodes can fail closed rather than inventing facts.

preconditions.description: Caller supplies a source_fragments array of strings (may be empty).

postconditions.description: Identical input always yields identical structured_facts. Classification, tidy, number extraction, and stable sort use no randomness, clocks, or host state.
structured_facts length equals the count of non-empty tidied input fragments.

side_effects.description: Produces structured facts in memory; does not log, persist, or transmit fragments.

provenance.author: enricopiovesan
provenance.spec_ref: registry#441 (browser chain linear pass-through) / registry#426 report chain port

authoring.test_evidence: capability-src/report-enrich-insights: 13 #[test] cases covering each signal class, number found/not found, sort stability, empty input, and the 1.1.0 source_fragments echo (verbatim, empties kept); cargo llvm-cov functions=100%, lines=98.25%, regions=98.58%.
